notes.title: v1.02 Hot patch coming this week!
notes.content:
A patch fixing several small issues that prevent progression through to the Sewers will be released this weekend! If you have gotten that far, and have gotten to the lifts that drop you under the graveyard, hang tight... !

Hope you're enjoying it.. having heaps of fun watching all the Youtube uploads!

Anyone with frame rate issues let me know. I see 70fps on some and 40 on others.... anyone below 30, let me know!?

Thanks

notes.title: Update v1.00 released!
notes.content:
Finally got to v1.00. 

This is the final official release. Only hot patches will follow for V1. V2 will include the remaining game levels.

In this release:

DEA-271 - Rottweiler gets stuck in landscape.
DEA-272 - Improvements to Glitch AI hunt and attack.

Enjoy!

notes.title: 0.98 Update Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25946987/17fdf557caac61c39dccbf3dd372a542669050b0.png[/img]

Hi, after a few weeks off, another update has been applied to Steam. A number of issues have been addressed and several feature requests included, with a major update to follow on the 20th.

DEA-246    Discrepant Novel Secret not findable
DEA-245    Instant kill hit damage happens randomly
DEA-235    Transition between New Haven and Transition Room 1 still bugged
DEA-213    Remove recharge timer on goggles.
DEA-211    Metric Units
DEA-207    Weird blue wall in house garage.
DEA-197    Fences look like they glow in the dark
DEA-192    Bathroom mirror is more like tv screen
DEA-188    Add more obvious low health warnings
DEA-184    Backing out from Transition One leaves me with black screen
DEA-171    Note upside down in TR1
DEA-102    New Haven - When crouching, the Player cannot be detected by enemies.

Summary of issues here:  [url=http://14.1.70.45:8080/secure/Dashboard.jspa]http://14.1.70.45:8080/secure/Dashboard.jspa[/url]

Due to changes in certain quest/inventory objects, EARLY ACCESS savegame updates will not always be forward compatible, and will need to be restarted.

As always, appreciate feedback and confirmation of issues being resolved. Also, any reviews on the Steam store would be great!

Thanks all

notes.title: Weekly Update 0.95 released.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25946987/fb14c648370cf25b79e2a325198f547c5d954fad.png[/img]

Latest update includes 2 new feature requests and 1 bugfix.

DEA-221 (Request) Third Person Mode (experimental)
DEA-222 (Bug) Player footsteps slide on turn in place when not melee.
DEA-224 (Request) Extend level 1 ending, and adjust Sue’s last moments to have more “context”

The ending of the tutorial level is now quite a bit more interesting for those who wish to restart and try it again. Watch her eyes!

It may be required to restart the game afresh, but see how you go. The savegames will be flagged in RED as a caution, just in case.

As with all updates and patches – please report any new issues that may have arisen as a result of the update, and they will get urgent attention, or the update will get rolled back.

Thanks!

notes.title: May 2017 Update!
notes.content:
Lots of updates to the game in May. [Over 140 acres of new locations and terrain has been added. These can now be explored and traversed by foot, train, car or bicycle. Some of it even by forklift!

Several new NPC's have been added along with lengthy audio dialog to extend the immersive plot.

A new inventory system and objectives menu has been added to simplify controls and to provide some guidance to players who want to be a little more led and directed through the game.

A complete pulse radar mapping system is also included, although you have to find the right gear to enable it!

All this and more are explained in more detail in our latest newsletter which you can find on our website here: http://www.discrepantgame.com/discrepant_newsletter.html

You can also sign up for future newsletters, or get involved in play testing and even offer to help with some overflow dev work if you are keen.

notes.title: Massive update scheduled!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Work has not stopped, and in fact more content is being added with a additional levels being added to Chapter 1 to improve game play and story line. Chapter 1 is likely to take 40% longer to complete as a result! A subway system, a complete urban city area, another complete neighborhood to explore, an extensive mutli-floor office building have been added. You can now catch the subway to move between places, and even drive a fully featured car to get around and explore whilst unraveling the plot.

A lot of new dialog has been added between Sebastian, Sue and the Manager, as well as additional side characters. 

I think we're having a bit of a creative splurge and unable to reign ourselves in ;-) just yet. Don't worry, still working toward a 2017 release, so it is coming.... promise!

Any interest in beta testings, please apply on our website, at http://www.discrepantgame.com/beta_access.html

All the best!
Incendio Software

notes.title: 2017 starts with the Subway Scene!
notes.content:
Hi all,

A number of new things will be in v0.60 which will be coming out in Jan.

1) Revised controls (as discussed on the forum)
2) Notebook "system"
3) Objective and Enemy Waypoint system
4) Car driving system added
4) A few maps have been brought into Chapter 1 from Chapter 2. 
- The Subway map is complete (you can ride trains, yes)
- The City map is in dev (you will be walking around streets, going up escalators, lifts, offices)

A sample of the subway can be found on our YouTube channel here:

https://youtu.be/99FOE7cW3BQ

Enjoy!
